entries.description: PREVENTIVE: declined to author E3 traps or classify the retrospective on a general 'proceed into all of that'. No error existed; the instruction was ordinary. PROTOCOL.md forbids both to the system under test by name — an AI grading traps it wrote is the vacuous-test failure mode, and an AI grading whether humans or AI caught each historical error is the instrument grading its own exam on the study's primary dataset. Second preventive catch, same shape as declining phase 26.
